verses.html: 27 Then Jesus and His disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say I am?”
verses.text: 27 Then Jesus and His disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say I am?”

verses.html: 28 They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
verses.text: 28 They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”

verses.html: 29 “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

verses.html: 28 But they said to him, saying, “John the Baptist, and others, Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

verses.html: 27 After that, Jesus and his apprentices left {the town of Bethsaida} and walked toward the small towns near the city of Caesarea Philippi. While they were walking, Jesus asked his apprentices, “Who do people say that I really am?”
verses.text: 27 After that, Jesus and his apprentices left {the town of Bethsaida} and walked toward the small towns near the city of Caesarea Philippi. While they were walking, Jesus asked his apprentices, “Who do people say that I really am?”

verses.html: 28 The apprentices replied, “People say that you are one of the prophets {who has come back to life}. {More specifically,} some people say that you are John the Baptizer. Other people say that you are the prophet Elijah.”
verses.text: 28 The apprentices replied, “People say that you are one of the prophets {who has come back to life}. {More specifically,} some people say that you are John the Baptizer. Other people say that you are the prophet Elijah.”

verses.html: 29 Then Jesus asked them, “As for you, who do you say that I really am?” Peter replied, “You are the Messiah!”
